dogecoin.text: Tesla Technoking Elon Musk tweeted Saturday that he was gathering wealth to “extend the light of consciousness to the stars.” Added Musk, “Dogecoin going to moon lol 🚀”
Tesla CEO Elon Musk agreed Monday to buy Twitter for $44 billion. Said Musk, “I am a huge advocate of free speech. Just ask any tax-evading, space-traveling, Dogecoin billionaire.”
